understanding.description: What the task asks for, in your own words

findings.description: Relevant facts from the code; for a bug, its root cause

steps.description: The concrete changes to make, in order

risks.description: What could break or needs attention

options.description: 2 to 4 short likely answers the requester can pick with one tap, each at most 40 characters
